summary: SPlayer-Next is a desktop music player (Vue renderer of an Electron app) with Chinese UI, a left nav sidebar and a bottom playback bar. Saved views: (1) library — local library track list with quality badges, album, like, duration and file size columns (#/library); (2) home — dashboard with greeting, weekly stats, random library pick, quick play modes, most-played tracks and recommended playlists (/); (3) stats — listening statistics with totals, heatmap, time-of-day chart, format donut and top songs/albums/artists (#/stats); (4) now-playing — full-screen immersive player, opened by clicking the cover in the bottom bar from #/liked (the current track has no lyrics, so no lyrics panel is shown); (5) settings — modal settings dialog with category sidebar, opened through the gear menu → 全局设置 from #/history. Not saved as separate views because they look almost the same as the library list: Liked, History, playlist detail pages, artist/album lists, Folders and Downloads.
